name: Zed
tagline: A fast, open-source code editor with built-in AI editing and agents, from the creators of Atom.
about: Zed is a high-performance code editor with real-time collaboration. AI is built in: inline edits, an agent panel, and support for your own model keys.
pros: Open source; works with your own model keys.
cons: Smaller extension library than VS Code.
Hosted AI beyond the free allowance is paid.
